entries.gap: Stability != Identifiability: heuristic steerability confounded with suboptimal optimization

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: A diagnostic that only re-confirms a shortcut already known in advance, surfacing no previously unmeasurable failure, is read as confirmatory rather than as a contribution.
reject_lessons_evaluated.reasoning: The estimator-disagreement quantity Stab_est is not a known shortcut being re-confirmed — nothing in the retrieved pool measures cross-estimator agreement at fixed data, and probe 2 of the coherence trace shows the quantity can be low precisely where bootstrap stability is near 1.0, which is a failure mode the field currently cannot see.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: Validating a synthetic-ground-truth instrument only on synthetic data, without demonstrating that the controlled finding transfers to real-world instances, leaves ecological validity unestablished.
reject_lessons_evaluated.reasoning: Both prompt sets are templated (OccuGender/WinoBias). The generation-plus-judge arm is the only non-templated measurement, and it is the weakest-specified part of the design. This is the C02 failure mode the candidate is closest to.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: Building the instrument around one contested definition of the target property means it cannot independently confirm that the definition is correct, and reviewers flag the resulting circularity.
reject_lessons_evaluated.reasoning: The oracle is not the evaluand's own judgment: the comparator distribution is generated by randomization (uniform draws on the sphere, random head draws), which is independent of the model under test. That is exactly the 'exchangeability-based null distribution' C02 names as an admissible independent oracle.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: Pairing a single-task or small-sample instrument with broad capability claims triggers a scope-mismatch rejection.
reject_lessons_evaluated.reasoning: Claims are scoped to gender-occupation stereotype directions in two named models; the card does not claim a general result about linear representations, and the estimand is declared over a stated prompt distribution.

entries.gap: Editing success assumed to imply privileged localization (Kim et al.) without random-direction optimal control (Wang & Veitch audit)

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: If the alternative locus is only a cosmetic variant of the assumed locus, reviewers fold the contribution back into prior work.
reject_lessons_evaluated.reasoning: Span-constrained b = c*theta is a strict nested submodel of free b, not a cosmetic variant: the two have different parameter counts and answer different questions, and the whole point of the finding in BLOCKING-1 is that they are not interchangeable.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: Quietly demonstrating the move only against the bypassed locus, or against outdated baselines, is the single most common reason this tactic fails to convince.
reject_lessons_evaluated.reasoning: The adversary is the strongest available: a random arm granted the identical IPO budget, plus a full-model upper bound. Premise P5 makes the equal-budget requirement explicit.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: A relocation shown to work but never explained reads as a stacked combination of existing components and forfeits the conceptual-lens credit.
reject_lessons_evaluated.reasoning: The mechanistic account of WHY the direction channel is the right locus is currently an algebraic argument (b enters only through b a^T, so the span restriction is well defined). That is correct but thin as a conceptual account; if the results come out as predicted, the paper needs a positive story about what the estimator-dependence implies for the linear representation hypothesis, not only a negative one.

gap_closure_reject_check.reasoning: Neither entry triggers a Reject pattern. The aggregate is borderline, driven by the anchor entry's ecological-validity lesson ('Validating a synthetic-ground-truth instrument only on synthetic data ... leaves ecological validity unestablished') — every prompt set in the design is templated, which is the documented way C02 instruments fail. The sibling entry's borderline on the mechanistic-account lesson is weaker and is a writing obligation rather than a design hole.

entries.signature_move: Construct controlled instances that block or independently vary ONE named confound while holding everything else fixed, with an oracle independent of the system under test, and report the divergence between apparent and de-confounded performance as the headline.
entries.where_in_core_mechanism: The two-factor-level intervention family: span-constrained b isolates the direction while holding site, objective and budget fixed; free b isolates the site while holding objective and budget fixed. The oracle is the randomization distribution. The headline is explicitly the divergence between what Level 1 certifies and what Level 3 measures.

entries.signature_move: Name the assumed locus, argue structurally why the property must manifest at an alternative locus, build the mechanism there, validate against an adversary that knows the new locus, and supply a mechanistic account of why the new locus carries the signal.
entries.where_in_core_mechanism: Steps 1-4 of the C01 recipe are present. Step 5, the mechanistic account, is the weakest: the candidate explains why the span-constrained locus is well posed, but not why estimator-dependence should be expected to carry the signal beyond the anisotropy argument.

recipe_application_check.reasoning: C02's move is instantiated concretely rather than gestured at. C01 is borderline only on its fifth step; the cited move is present, not bypassed, so no sub-pattern swap is warranted.

anti_pattern_check.reasoning: The nearest anti-pattern risk is 'audit paper with no constructive output'. It does not match: the candidate ships a reusable diagnostic with named estimands and a positive-control arm that, if it fires, constructively identifies the direction as the effective carrier rather than merely negating a prior claim.

paper_pointed_threat.subsumption_argument: Wang & Veitch already establish that optimal localized editing at random sites matches probe-selected sites, and a reviewer may read the present candidate as that result transplanted to a new domain. The subsumption fails on one specific point: their design manipulates only the site, so their null carries no information about whether a DIRECTION at a fixed site is privileged. The span-constrained submodel b = c*theta is a factor level their reparameterization admits but never instantiates, and it is the only arm in which the supplied direction is load-bearing. The candidate's other independent contribution — Stab_est, and the test of which stability quantity predicts privilege — has no counterpart in that paper at all.
paper_pointed_threat.parametric_family_concern: The equal-budget random comparator is, in other vocabularies, a placebo arm with matched titration, and the five-estimator sweep is a specification-curve / multiverse analysis. Neither family was surfaced by the retrieved pool. Before investing, run a scoop-check on the phrases 'specification curve analysis' and 'randomization inference nuisance parameter', and on 'sham control' in the causal-mediation literature — the concern is not that a paper scoops the LLM application, but that a statistics-side reviewer asks why the design is not simply cited as one of these.

falsification_structure_check.load_bearing_variable: theta-hat itself, the supplied direction in the span-constrained channel
falsification_structure_check.reasoning: The control permutes the producer of theta-hat while holding site, objective and budget fixed, and its predicted effect is stated on |Delta_M|, the downstream pronoun-gap metric, not on theta-hat's own value — so it clears the anti-tautology guard. The only numeric content is the near-zero optimal-intervention gap attributed to arxiv:2502.11447; the invented 0.5-sigma bar from the previous draft is gone.

blocking_findings_disposition.basis: The finding is reading_robust and the algebra is correct: a free-b optimum at a fixed site does not take theta as an argument, so the three arms coincide. The candidate under audit was authored to confront it via the nested span-constrained channel, which is the structural_requirement the finding itself names. Implication for the verdict: the obstacle is confronted rather than avoided, so it does not cap below advance for THIS candidate — but it does mean the original card's headline result was unfalsifiable, and the paper must say so explicitly rather than presenting the two-channel design as a mere refinement.

The Monte Carlo arithmetic checks out against the extreme-value behaviour of the half-normal, and the rank p-value column converging to 0.0455 = P(|Z| >= 2) is the correct consistency check. The candidate replaces the max with a quantile plus an exact rank p-value and names R_n with a selection rule, which is precisely the structural_requirement.

The provenance is documented in the repository (v2_null_check.json carries priv_gap_heuristic = 0.5 beside a 'replace with real bootstrap' note), so this is checkable rather than a judgment call. The candidate's falsification_prediction carries no invented bar, which falsification_structure_check independently confirms.

Connector degradation is recorded in the run's own .connectors_degraded sentinel and every lit_table row's retrieved_via column. The collision check behind the Level-4 novelty verdict therefore rests on web search and model recall, not on verified retrieval. This caps confidence in novelty completeness, not in the mechanism, and it is the one finding that must be cleared before submission rather than before implementation.

phase1_output.json genuinely lacks method_lineage, so the regression check could not run. The candidate records the avoided node explicitly (it is not proposing 'run a permutation test'), which is the best available substitute, but it is not a substitute for the lineage tree.

verdict_rationale: falsification_structure_check.verdict = sound on every sub-answer, and anti_pattern_check.matched_pattern_id = null. The two borderlines are genuine but neither hits the central argument: gap_closure_reject_check's ecological-validity lesson ('Validating a synthetic-ground-truth instrument only on synthetic data ... leaves ecological validity unestablished') bears on the generation arm rather than on the identification strategy, and recipe_application_check's C01 borderline is a fifth-step writing obligation, not a bypassed move. paper_pointed_threat.addressable_via = not_needed because the span-constrained factor level is exactly what arxiv:2502.11447 does not instantiate. All three original blocking findings are upheld and all three are confronted by the audited candidate rather than avoided, so the advance is over a redesign, not over a patch.

concerns_for_phase4.concern: Every prompt set is templated; ecological validity rests on the generation-plus-judge arm, which is the least specified component.
concerns_for_phase4.suggested_response: Specify the generation arm to the same standard as the logit arm — fixed decoding parameters, a stated judge model and rubric, inter-rater agreement against a small human-labelled subset, and a fluency guard so a degenerate arm cannot win by breaking the model. Alternatively scope the claim to templated probes explicitly and say so in the title's setting.

concerns_for_phase4.concern: The C01 mechanistic account (why the estimator locus carries the signal) is currently an anisotropy argument rather than a theory.
concerns_for_phase4.suggested_response: The Park et al. linear-representation results (arxiv:2403.03867) give a route: their causal-inner-product construction is exactly a statement that the meaningful geometry is whitened, which predicts that mass-mean and LDA disagree unless the whitening is accounted for. Framing Stab_est as a test of that prediction turns a negative measurement into a positive claim.

concerns_for_phase4.concern: Novelty verdict rests on degraded retrieval (UNREPAIRED-1) and alias_terms were built without a lineage tree (UNREPAIRED-2).
concerns_for_phase4.suggested_response: Re-run Phase 0 and Phase 3.1 with live connectors, and query the three named alias families by hand. The mechanism does not depend on the unverifiable rows, so implementation can proceed in parallel.

concerns_for_phase4.concern: Compute is tight against the stated envelope: about 1.4x the GPU line and about 4x the API line.
concerns_for_phase4.suggested_response: R_n is the named lever. Run R_n = 60 for the pilot pass and raise it to 200 only for the sites that clear the pilot, which preserves the p-value resolution where it matters and spends nothing on sites with no effect.
